snippet.title: Docked - Deep Waters DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into Docked's first expansion, Deep Waters! 🌊🤿

Discover a new chapter in Port Wake's journey as you work towards achieving international port status in a new campaign mission! Master the powerful new Magnet Gripper attachment and put your operational skills to the test with 12 brand-new jobs.

Deep Waters is available today on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series: saber.games/docked

Join the community on Reddit: https://sabr.gg/DockedReddit
